note: Shoshone NF campground on the Beartooth Highway (US-212), about 3.5 mi W of the Chief Joseph Highway junction: a recently upgraded loop on an open bench above Crazy Creek and the Clarks Fork. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-23): 16 sites, 28-ft spurs, first-come only (no rec.gov listing), 16-day limit, late May - early/mid Sep, water system inoperable ($15; $20 with water), vault toilets. Not waterfront confirmed (creek ~60 m+ through conifers). Pin fine. Phone empty -> (307) 527-6921.
